params.body:
## Why

The list of people who get the newsletter and the record of who gives live on two pages. Nobody could see which readers already support, and which do not yet.

## What changes

A button "Show who supports" on `/newsletter-admin` lays the donations next to the list, matched on email address (capitals make no difference):

- per person: the total given net of refunds, the number of gifts, the date of the last one, and a label when a recurring gift was collected in the last 45 days;
- those who give most come first;
- the Show menu gets "Supporters" and "Not supporting yet";
- at the top: how many people on the list support, how much in all, how many with a recurring gift;
- a count, without names, of the people who give without being on the list. They did not ask for the newsletter.

In this view the columns "Wants", "Came from" and "Since" make room for the amounts.

## Who sees it

Only people who may open the donations section as well. Someone with the newsletter section alone gets no button, and adding `?support` to the address gives them nothing. The ledger is loaded only when the view is asked for, since it goes through all payments.

If Mollie cannot be reached, the page says that the amounts come from the sign-up records only.

## Limits

Somebody who gives under another address than the one on the list is shown as not supporting.

## Checked

- `npm test`: 99 pass, 3 of them new (adding up per address, refunds and unpaid payments, when a gift counts as recurring).
- `npm run build` passes.
- Looked at in a browser on desktop width with made-up donors and subscribers, and the two new filters tried.

## Not checked

With the real payments from Mollie. The closed view for a newsletter-only person was not walked through in the browser.
params.title: The newsletter list can show who on it already supports, and how much
